Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding meal and rest periods for employees of health care facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to meal and rest periods for employees of healthcare facilities; amending RCW 49.28.150; and adding a new section tochapter 49.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Because employees of health care facilities are not engaged inthe type of work that allows employees to take intermittent meal andrest periods in lieu of scheduled and uninterrupted meal and restperiods, employees of health care facilities must be provided scheduledand uninterrupted meal and rest periods of a duration no less thanspecified in rules adopted by the department of labor and industriesunder this chapter or as otherwise agreed to be provided by theemployer, whichever is longer in duration. (2) The definitions in RCW 49.28.130 apply to this section.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 49.28.150 and 2002 c 112 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of labor and industries shall investigate complaints p. 1 HB 1642of violations of RCW 49.28.140 and section 1 of this act. A violationof RCW 49.28.140 or section 1 of this act is a class 1 civil infractionin accordance with chapter 7.80 RCW, except that the maximum penalty isone thousand dollars for each infraction up to three infractions. Ifthere are four or more violations of RCW 49.28.140, section 1 of thisact, or any combination thereof for a health care facility, theemployer is subject to a fine of two thousand five hundred dollars forthe fourth violation, and five thousand dollars for each subsequentviolation. The department of labor and industries is authorized toissue and enforce civil infractions according to chapter 7.80 RCW.
